verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ex aj Jerusalén, k'eanhekxi wa'an, te wach' eyiko' yujto scheklajxik'e in tzikikial t'a he kal.

Haxo yol yib'anhk'inal tik, a k'ik'k 'inal ol musankanok, ichato ol kan juntzanhxo nación t'a skal jun niwan k'ik' k'inal. Ha exxo tik, a in Jehová in tik ol wak' sakil k'inal t'ayex, ol cheklajel in tzikikial t'a he kal.
Ha juntzanh niwak nación chi', ol jawok t'ayex yuj he sakil k'inal chi'. Ha heb' winh rey, ol jawok heb' winh ul yil in tzikikial ol cheklaj chi'.

K'eanhek k'elan, tzeyilan t'a he patik eyichanh to a masanil heb' eyetchonhab', ol laj smolb'ej sb'a heb' sjax t'ayex. Ha heb' eyal eyuninal, najat ol kot heb', mek'b'il heb' ol ul ak'jokkan heb' t'ayex.
Ayik ol eyilan icha chi', ol ex k'e juknaj he tzalaji, ol ex te tzalaj wal. Yujto ol laj yik'kot sb'eyumal juntzanh nación ay t'a sk'axepal ha' mar, ol ul yak'ankan heb' t'ayex.

Ol majel sat he lum tik yuj jantak nok' camello ol yik'kot heb' aj Madián yet' heb' aj Efa. Ol jawokpax masanil heb' aj Sabá, yet'nak k'e'en oro heb' yet' incienso. Ol yalanel wach' lolonel heb' t'ayin Jehová in tik, yuj tas tzin k'ulej.

Masanil nok' kalnel ay t'a Cedar, ol eyikej nok'. Masanil nok' ch'ak kalnel ay t'a Nebaiot, a nok' ol eyak'lab'ej, yik ol eyak'an nok' silab'il t'a waltar, haton silab' nib'ab'il wu'uj. Icha chi' ol wutej, yik ay yelk'och in templo t'ayex.
Ol eyalan icha tik: ¿Tas juntzanh skot chi', icha skot asun, ma icha sk'och nok' paramuch t'a yet'tal?

Ha jun ol eyil chi', haton te' barco skot t'a sk'axepal ha' mar, b'ab'el skot te' yik Tarsis yuj te'. Wan yik'jikot heb' eyuninal aykanb'at t'a najat yuj heb', yet'nak k'e'en oro heb' yet' k'e'en plata. Ol in ik'jokcha'anh a in Jehová he Diosal, Ha inxonhej Ochi. Ha in pax ol ex wak' b'inajok.

Ha heb' ch'ok nacional, a heb' ol b'oanxik'e smuro'al he chonhab', haxo heb' sreyal heb' ol ex ak'an serwil. Wach'chom yuj yowal in k'o'ol ix wak'och eyahelal, haxo tikne'ik, yuj in wach'k'olal tz'ok'xi in k'ol t'ayex.
Ha spuerta'il he chonhab', jakannhej t'a k'uhalil yet' t'ak'walil yik syik'kot sb'eyumal juntzanh nación chi' t'ayex, yik sjawipax sreyal heb' t'a eyichanh.
Ha juntzanh niwak nación, ma heb' rey manh ol ex ak'an serwil, ol satjokel heb'. Manhxa b'aj ol cheklaj jab'ok heb'.
Ha jantak sb'eyumal lum Líbano ol ik'chajkot t'ayex: Haton te' taj, te' k'ub'taj yet' te' tzikap. Ol och te' swach'il yelwanub'ok in templo, yik ol wik'cha'anh jun lugar chi' b'aj ol in ajok.

Masanil yinhtilal heb' ix ex ixtan chi', ol jawok heb' yak'em sb'a t'ayex. Masanil heb' ix ex chakaneli, ol ul em kuman heb' t'ayex, ol yalan heb' t'ayex icha tik: Ha ex aj chonhab' Sion ex tik, yiknhej Jehová eyaji, haton sDiosal Israel Haxonhej Ochi, xcham heb'.
Wach'chom aktab'il ex kan t'a peka', chakb'il ex eli, manhxa mach tzek' b'aj ek'nak ex chi', palta haxo tikne'ik, ol wak' eyik'jicha'anh yet' he b'inajnakilal yuj masanil chonhab' t'a junelnhej.

Ha juntzanh nación chi', ol yak' he wa'el heb' te wach', haxo heb' sreyal heb', ol yik'kot sb'eyumal heb', ol ex yak'an serwil heb', icha syutej junok ix nunab'il yak'an chunok yune'. Icha chi' ol aj eyojtakaneli to a in Jehová he Diosal in, he Kolumal waji, a in sDiosal in winhaj Jacob, tzex in kolo'.

Ol in k'ex masanil tas ay t'ayex: Ha k'e'en oro ol wak' sk'exulok k'e'en bronce, haxo k'e'en plata ol wak' sk'exulok k'e'en hierro. Ha k'e'en bronce ol wak' sk'exulok te te', haxo k'e'en hierro chi' ol wak' sk'exulok k'e'en komon k'e'en. Ha heb' eyajalil, t'a stojolal ol ex sch'olb'itej heb', yuj chi' junk'olal ol ex ajok.

Ha t'a he lu'um chi', manhxa milojcham anima, owal yet' jantak chukal ol ujok. Manhxa tas ol satel t'a yol he makb'en chi' yuj owal. Ha in ol ex in kol icha junok muro, ol in eyik'cha'anh yujto ix ex in kolo'.
Manhxalaj ol och yok k'u eyu'uj, ma yok k'e'en uj t'ak'walil, yujto a in Jehová sakil k'inal ol in aj t'ayex t'a junelnhej. Ha in he Diosal in tik ol ex wak' b'inajok.

Ha jun sakil k'inal ol wak' t'ayex chi', a ol ochkan sk'exulok yok k'u yet' yok k'e'en uj. Ha jun chi', malaj b'ak'inh ol tupok, yujto a in Jehová in sakil k'inal ol in aj t'ayex t'a junelnhej. Manhxa b'ak'inh ol ex kusok.
Masanil heb' eyetchonhab', wach'nhej ol aj spensar heb'. Ol yikejpax slum heb' t'a junelnhej. Lajan ol aj heb' icha swol junok te' awb'en te' awab'il wu'uj. Ol in k'ulej jun chi' yuj wik'jicha'anh.

Ha heb' kennhej sb'isul t'a he kal, ol k'ib' wal sb'isul heb', te tek'an ol aj heb' icha junok niwan chonhab'. Ayik ol k'och stiempo'al yelk'och juntzanh tik, a in wal Jehová in ol wak'elk'och t'a elanhchamel, xchi Jehová chi'.
